finding: Robustness summary says NOT_SPECIFIED while business_policy.json says FROZEN.
recommended_action: Trace the metadata field in the robustness builder. Document the discrepancy and prepare a new versioned summary only after review; do not overwrite frozen outputs.
evidence_required: Root-cause note, approved correction plan, and hash-linked new-version output if correction is authorized.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: Authoritative policy status is traceable, the discrepancy is explained, and any corrected artifact has a new version and independent validation.

finding: The portfolio-return convention and simplified turnover/cost assumptions require independent review.
recommended_action: Independently verify exposure-weighted simple returns, signal timing, cash return assumptions, rebalancing, turnover, and costs.
evidence_required: Written methodology review, formula-level reconciliation, and test cases including boundary dates.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: An independent reviewer reproduces selected daily returns, turnover, cumulative wealth, and drawdown from documented inputs without unexplained differences.

finding: Transaction costs were tested with simplified basis-point scenarios rather than verified execution records.
recommended_action: Extend the cost model to document brokerage, taxes, bid-ask spread, slippage, financing, market impact, and realistic turnover mechanics where applicable.
evidence_required: Transparent cost assumptions, source references, sensitivity results, and reconciliation to the intended instrument.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: All included cost components are documented, reproducible, and independently reviewed; omitted components are explicitly disclosed.

finding: Chronological halves and alternative mappings are descriptive sensitivity checks, not independent validation.
recommended_action: Define additional untouched evaluation periods and stress conditions before examining their results. Keep the policy frozen for each declared test.
evidence_required: Predeclared test plan, frozen configuration hashes, period-level results, and leakage checks.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: Evaluation periods and metrics are specified in advance, the test data do not inform calibration, and results include both favorable and unfavorable periods.

finding: The current report compares adaptive exposure with a static baseline, but does not establish superiority to every reasonable alternative.
recommended_action: Compare against predeclared simple alternatives using the same periods, return definitions, and cost assumptions.
evidence_required: Side-by-side metrics, common evaluation dates, and documented comparison methodology.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: All strategies use consistent data, dates, cost assumptions, and metric definitions; differences are independently reconciled.

finding: Historical analysis does not establish operational reliability or safe live execution.
recommended_action: Define data freshness checks, missing-data handling, logging, alerting, rollback, and a human review process.
evidence_required: Operational runbook, failure simulations, logs, and documented manual override procedures.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: Simulated data failures and invalid signals are detected, logged, and handled according to the approved runbook.

finding: The current historical analysis does not define ongoing monitoring or a response to model degradation.
recommended_action: Specify monitoring for data quality, regime frequency, exposure changes, realized risk, and divergence from historical assumptions.
evidence_required: Monitoring specification, alert thresholds, review cadence, and escalation procedure.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: Each monitored metric has an owner, documented threshold, review cadence, and response action.

finding: No paper-trading or shadow-monitoring evidence is established by the current report.
recommended_action: After analytical and operational gates are met, define a time-bounded paper-trading or shadow-monitoring protocol.
evidence_required: Timestamped signals, simulated decisions, expected versus observed execution assumptions, incident logs, and a predeclared review report.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: The trial meets predeclared data-quality, operational, tracking, and review criteria before a separate deployment decision is considered.
